name: Puppet pose and sway
visual_intent: Jointed puppet limbs rotate from their pivots between key poses and sway on their rods, giving shadow-theatre performance without a full rig.
implementation_summary: Jointed puppet limbs rotate from their pivots between key poses and sway on their rods, giving shadow-theatre performance without a full rig.
runtime_api: Studio.kit.mythic.pose(tl, puppet, at, {part: degrees}, {duration, steps}) + sway(tl, pieces, from, to, {degrees, period, steps}); steps: true holds each pose for two frames at 24 fps (12 updates a second, 'on twos'); M.stepped(ease, duration, fps) for any tween

validation.evidence: Kit self-test tests/test-mythic.py (Playwright Chromium: build, seek determinism) and frame review of the mythic-film scaffold (portrait) on Windows, 2026-11-23. Not yet rendered through HyperFrames on the Apple M2 host, so not approved.
